article.title: HighLevel Ad Manager加入ChatGPT廣告建案與報表
article.title_en: HighLevel adds ChatGPT campaign building and reporting
article.summary: HighLevel讓廣告主在Ad Manager連接OpenAI Ads帳戶，建立及衡量ChatGPT廣告活動。
article.summary_en: HighLevel lets advertisers connect an OpenAI Ads account to build and measure ChatGPT campaigns in Ad Manager.
highlights: 廣告組可加入描述適用對話的情境提示，素材使用標題、描述及方形圖片。
帳單及廣告審核仍由OpenAI處理；推出時使用Standard活動類型。
highlights_en: Ad groups use context hints, while creative combines a title, description and square image.
OpenAI retains billing and ad review; launch campaigns use the Standard type.
article.why: 代理商可把ChatGPT活動與既有渠道放在同一管理介面，決定哪些情境提示、素材及轉換事件需獨立準備。
article.why_en: Agencies can decide which context hints, assets and conversion events need separate preparation within the shared management interface.
article.next_step: 用一項明確的產品查詢情境草擬廣告，對照情境提示、方形素材、落地頁及轉換事件，再進入平台審閱流程。
article.next_step_en: Draft one product-query context and reconcile hints, square creative, destination and conversion events before review.
article.detail: 這是HighLevel的渠道整合，並非ChatGPT廣告首次推出。官方文件列出觸及、點擊及轉換三種目標，並提供裝置與位置等報表分段。自訂受眾需要至少25,000名匹配使用者，活動範本仍屬後續計劃。團隊可先由帳戶已有資格及實際支援的市場開始確認投放安排。
article.detail_en: This is a HighLevel channel integration, not the original ChatGPT Ads launch. Objectives cover reach, clicks and conversions, with device and location reporting. Custom audiences need25,000 matched users and templates remain planned. Confirm account eligibility and supported markets first.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
